title: Routing Gatekeeper: predictive prefetch scorecard and decision ladder for cross-region reroutes
creator: Elena Park
description: Implement a Routing Gatekeeper microservice that computes a predictive prefetch scorecard and decision ladder used by the smart router to determine when to reroute traffic to alternate regions or fallback model variants. This ticket covers the score computation, thresholds, telemetry hooks, simulation harness, and an ops playbook for cutover and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard returns a numerical readiness score (0-100) for a target region and model variant within 50ms for typical queries
Decision ladder config stored in config service with 3 policy tiers: immediate-failover, hedged-reroute, conservative-retry
Routing decisions annotate traces and emit metrics for score, selected policy, and reason-code
Canary simulation demonstrates <1% additional tail latency when routing to hedged region under synthetic load
Playbook steps for ops called out and verified: traffic-shadow, slow-roll reroute, rollback path
runbook_steps: 1) Activate traffic-shadow for 1% of production traffic to target region for 30 minutes
2) Validate scorecard outputs stable (>70 readiness) and KV cache heatmap matches baseline
3) Enable hedged-reroute policy for low-risk routes (latency tolerant) with hedging budget 5%
4) Monitor latency_p95, model_error_rate, and routing_rejects for 15 minutes
5) If regressions exceed threshold, flip policy to conservative-retry and initiate rollback
6) Post-mortem: record decisions, telemetry snapshots, and follow-up tickets
design_decisions: Use a composite readiness score: 40% KV cache warmth, 25% recent tail latency, 20% node capacity headroom, 15% model compatibility check
KV cache warmth estimated via exponential-decay hit rate window (last 10 minutes), normalized to 0-100
Model compatibility check includes quantization variant compatibility and tokenizer version match — binary pass/fail mapped to 0/100
Decision ladder will be rule-backed with pluggable ML later: immediate-failover (score<35), hedged-reroute (35<=score<65), conservative-retry (score>=65)
Hedging budget is enforced per-customer via tokenized allowance to avoid cost blowouts; default budget 5% of requests per minute
Routing Gatekeeper will be deployed as control-plane sidecar per-region, with read-only TTL cache for scores and quorum fallback
implementation_tasks: API: /v1/score?region=&model_variant=&route_id — implement scoring endpoint returning numeric score and reason-codes
Scoring engine: implement KV warmth estimator, tail-latency probe, capacity headroom sampler, compatibility check
Config: expose decision ladder and hedging budget via config-service with rollout flags
Telemetry: add traces (opentelemetry) and metrics (prometheus) for score, reason-codes, selected policy
Simulation: create synthetic load job in performance repo to exercise hedged-reroute and capture tail latencies
Console: add scorecard viz and per-route gating toggles to staging Console for operators
testing_plan: Unit tests for each scoring component with edge cases (no cache, zero capacity, tokenizer mismatch)
Integration test: end-to-end routing decision in staging under controlled latency injection
Chaos test: forcibly throttle a region's GPUs and validate gatekeeper flips to hedged-reroute/rollback
Load test: compare baseline vs hedged-reroute P95/P99 under 3 traffic profiles (chat, completion, embeddings)
Canary: 0.1% shadow -> 1% hedged -> 5% hedged if stable
monitoring_and_alerts: Create dashboard: routing_gatekeeper/scorecard with histograms of scores, reason_code rates, and per-region heatmaps
Alerts: score_drop_rate > 10% in 5m for any region -> P1 alert
Alerts: hedged_reroute_failure_rate > 0.5% over 10m -> investigate compatibility or capacity issues
SLO: decisions latency 99th < 200ms, enforced by synthetic probes
